verdict.rationale: Trello has built-in AI features, so it could plausibly act as an MCP client, and the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that users can plug external MCP servers into Trello for it to use. The MCP mention (trello-docs-6) describes the opposite role, connecting Trello to AI tools as a server, and Power-Ups are an adjacent integration mechanism, so neither earns credit here.
